subject: Blended budget window + adding new inference routes — follow-up
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@streamlinehealth.com>, Scott Huang <scott.huang@streamlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pricing window & proposed pilot routes

Hi Lisa / Scott —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good walkthrough of your expansion goals for Q3. I wanted to capture the things we discussed and propose a clear next step so we can size a blended pricing window for the three routes you mentioned (summarization, clinical-check, and custom rerank):

Summary of ask / constraints
- Target: 3–5M tokens / month to start, ramping to ~20M over 3–6 months across the three routes.
- Primary constraint: total budget target for inference is ~$1,200–1,800 per month initially, with flexibility for the pilot if unit economics look favorable.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for clinical-check; summarization can tolerate higher p95.

What we proposed on the call
- Pilot: dedicate a reserved pool with autoscale headroom for peak day, plus a blended unit price for the pilot period.
- Blended guidance: we suggested a target between $700–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on route mix and quantization profile.

Requested from you
- Can you confirm expected token split across routes for month 1 (rough numbers are fine)? Example: Summarization 50%, Clinical-check 30%, Rerank 20%.
- Are there any contractual constraints (PO lead time, internal procurement windows) we should know about?

Next steps
- If you can share a rough token split and monthly budget band, Aditya will draft 2 blended pricing options (conservative & aggressive) and I’ll put together a pilot scope + success criteria doc. I’ll also attach the quick Excel you can tweak.

Attachments: Streamline_route_estimates.xlsx (estimates template)

Best,
Evelyn
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@streamlinehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Scott Huang <scott.huang@streamlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing window & proposed pilot routes

Thanks, Evelyn —

Quick answers below (we pulled these from our usage estimates):
- Expected month 1 gross tokens: 4.2M
  - Summarization: ~2.3M
  - Clinical-check: ~1.1M
  - Rerank: ~0.8M
- Budget band: For pilot, leadership gave us $1,500–$2,200/mo. For expansion, we’re aiming to keep unit cost under $800/1M if possible.
- Procurement: PO is straightforward but takes 2–3 weeks. We can sign a pilot SOW with a PO after approval — speed depends on buying committee time.

One clarification: the clinical-check path has a higher average token per call (we estimated 420 tokens/call) vs. summarization (avg 280). That matters for unit economics.

Attached a quick snapshot of expected route volumes — let us know if you want additional granularity.

Thanks,
Lisa
Head of Integrations
Streamline Health

Attachment: Streamline_route_estimates_filled.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@streamlinehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing window & proposed pilot routes

Lisa / team —

Appreciate the detail. I ran two blended scenarios based on your month 1 split (4.2M tokens):

Scenario A — conservative (smaller discounts, preserves runway)
- Rates used: Summarization $1,100 / 1M, Clinical-check $1,600 / 1M, Rerank $950 / 1M
- Weighted blended unit: ((2.3*1100) + (1.1*1600) + (0.8*950)) / 4.2 ≈ $1,232 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly spend: $4.2 * $1,232 ≈ $5,174 (pilot note: this is standard hosted pricing with modest pilot discount)

Scenario B — pilot-friendly (commitment + route mix discount)
- Rates used after pilot discount: Summarization $850 / 1M, Clinical-check $1,200 / 1M, Rerank $700 / 1M
- Weighted blended unit ≈ $920 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly spend: $4.2 * $920 ≈ $3,864 (fits within your stated pilot budget range)

Notes / options
- If you can commit to a 3-month pilot with a small committed monthly token floor (e.g., 3M/mo), we can lock Scenario B pricing and provide one-time implementation credits.
- Alternative: keep hosted but route clinical-check to a quantized variant (lower perf but cheaper) — that can shave another ~10–20% off the blended unit.

I attached a short PDF that shows the math and a comparison of route-level unit economics. If this looks OK, I’ll convert Scenario B into a formal pilot SOW + DocuSign and include an SLA appendix for the clinical-check route.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-present-v2.pdf

From: Scott Huang <scott.huang@streamlinehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@streamlinehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing window & proposed pilot routes

Aditya / Evelyn —

Scenario B looks good and sits in the range we expected. A couple of operational asks before we finalize:
- Can you include an explicit DocuSign link for the pilot SOW and the 3-month commitment language? Procurement will require that.
- Include an appendix with the fallback routing policy (if clinical-check capacity is constrained, fallback to quantized variant with retained p95 target of <550ms).
- Please show the unit price impact if we route 40% of clinical-check traffic to the quantized variant (we want to see the blended math).

If you can get the SOW + DocuSign over early next week we’ll route it to procurement immediately.

Thanks,
Scott
VP, Engineering
Streamline Health
